edgeChatGPT.stageReached: Prerequisite inspection before any commercial microimage click.
prerequisitesForBothImages: Verify the exact ordinary Riftlet build and an Edge write route through its real microimage click entry.
Verify an isolated, authorized, signed-in Edge ChatGPT session with a dedicated unsent draft, neutral existing text, a selection and a pre-existing attachment.
For each distinct image, bind the click-time process, window, tab, document and editor; preserve the baseline and the first new attachment across the second click.
For each image, capture separate original-draft evidence for actual upload start and final completion. An input event or thumbnail alone proves neither.
